releaseNotes:
1. Target Feeder Line Saving: Saving lines between markers automatically detects and saves into the corresponding feeder file, with interactive feeder target selection.
2. Right Drawer Fit to Screen: The '[ ]' icon button smoothly animates camera to fit feeder bounds with padding, auto-enables visibility, and closes drawer.
3. Feeder Name Display & Layout: Tamil feeder titles wrap across 2 lines with enhanced 15px typography preventing truncation; English names wrap cleanly.
4. Master 29 Feeders Synchronization: Restored Feeder 22 (110kV Palaiyur - Sembanarkoil) with exact sl_no sequence across Pre-monsoon, Routine Patrol, and Special Work.
